scene: The plaque reveals city transit lines converging right beside the piazza.
picture: A flat side view along the piazza pavement. On the left, a sleek silver hover metro waits at a glass boarding gate. In the centre, a red double-decker hover bus idles, beside the silver-haired grandmother in her pink tracksuit and white dog. On the right, a winged striped gondola drone floats beside a mooring post.
shown: a sleek silver metro pod waiting with open doors on the left
a red double-decker hover bus idling at the stop in the centre
a winged striped gondola drone moored at a post on the right
